derivations.quote: Put $\rho=(s/W)/m^\tau$, not the role permutation of earlier pages. Since $s/W<m$, some rational $\tau<1$ gives $\rho<1$; this is where $s<Wm$ is used. Dividing by $m^{t\tau}$ gives $m^{-t\tau}F(m^t)\le\rho\,m^{-(t-1)\tau}F(m^{t-1})+O(1)$, since $e^\tau+1\le 2e^\tau$. Unrolling gives a geometric sum with ratio $\rho<1$, so $F(m^t)=O(m^{t\tau})$. A field of $e$ radix-$q$ digits has $\Theta(e)$ bits, because $q$ is fixed, so $e$ is proportional to $u$ and the interchange costs $O(Vu^\tau)$. The butterfly layer uses a second fixed network, also with $s<Wm$, and runs the same recursion on the $d$ selected chunks, so it costs $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ once $\lambda'$ exceeds two exponents.

relations.quote: The machine performs its address moves by [Fast interchange of address fields](fast-address-interchange.md).
It performs its butterfly layers by [Fast simultaneous butterfly layers](fast-butterfly-layers.md).
The machine computes its convolution by [Convolution with retained transform order and cancelled permutations](ring-convolution-retained-order.md).
The machine recovers its coefficients by [Fixed-point precision and exact recovery](fixed-point-precision.md).
The machine places its coefficient list by the [Chinese-remainder map to prime cyclic axes](crt-address-map.md).
It disproves the [n log n optimality conjecture](nlogn-conjecture.md) for this model.

symbols.name: chunk digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of radix-$q$ digits in a chunk at a recursion level, $e=m^t$.
symbols.quote: Let $e=m^t$ be the number of radix-$q$ digits in a chunk at recursion level $t$, where $m$ is the number of fields per chunk and $q$ is a fixed prime.

symbols.name: recursion level
symbols.meaning: The recursion level of a chunk, so that a chunk at this level has $m^t$ digits.
symbols.quote: Let $e=m^t$ be the number of radix-$q$ digits in a chunk at recursion level $t$, where $m$ is the number of fields per chunk and $q$ is a fixed prime.

symbols.name: time per volume
symbols.meaning: The time divided by $V$ at a recursion level, as a function of the chunk digit count $e$.
symbols.quote: Let $F(e)$ be the time divided by $V$ at that level.

symbols.name: recursion ratio
symbols.meaning: The ratio $(s/W)/m^\tau$, which is below one for a suitable rational $\tau<1$.
symbols.quote: Put $\rho=(s/W)/m^\tau$, not the role permutation of earlier pages.
